summary: More than most people, a fast, restless mind and a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you think and talk your way through anything, you build things that last and carry real weight. It rewards you when you reach for it.
body: More than most people, a fast, restless mind and a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you think and talk your way through anything, you build things that last and carry real weight. It rewards you when you reach for it. Thorough and exacting, with little patience for small talk. Thoughts may come through carefully here. There can be a natural awareness of consequence, timing, and the weight of what gets said.
gift: At your best: you think and talk your way through anything, and you build things that last and carry real weight.
shadow: The trap: you overthink it, or talk when you should feel — or you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes.
integration: Let thinking and speech and discipline and limits cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Thorough and exacting, with little patience for small talk.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you think and you build things that last work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
